source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Create a concise title detailing the type of accident, location, and date.

3. Provide the exact date and time the accident occurred.

4. Document the names, job titles, and contact information of everyone involved, including witnesses.

5. Record the exact location of the accident, including information about the work environment if relevant (e.g., lighting conditions, temperature, machinery in use).

6. Clearly describe the sequence of events leading up to the accident in chronological order. Be sure to include any unusual circumstances or warning signs.

7. Document the nature of the injuries suffered. If there were no injuries, include this information as well.

8. Specify the immediate responses taken to address the accident, such as first aid administered, ambulance called, or staff alerted.

9. List any equipment or machinery involved and if any malfunctioned or contributed to the accident.

10. Detail the preliminary cause of the accident based on initial observations.

11. Collect photographs or videos of
